## About
Charbonier Service is owned by Harry Dunn, and our shop sits at 520 Shackelford Rd in Florissant. Harry's promise is simple: you will be treated with the respect you deserve, whether the job is big or small.
Our mechanics love to work on cars and are happy to turn a wrench. We use the latest diagnostic technology so we can do good work and get you back on the road quickly.
We know car repair is rarely fun or convenient, so we try to make it as easy as we can. Customers have rated us 4.3 from 201 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Brake jobs: Brake work for your car or truck. One reviewer came in for a brake job and made us her new shop.
- Alternator changes: One customer had her alternator changed and was in and out the same day.
- Emissions: One reviewer said her emissions visit was quick and friendly.
- Tire and wheel service: Tire and wheel work to keep you rolling safely.
- Preventative maintenance: Regular maintenance options to keep your car healthy and on the road longer.

## FAQ
Q: Do you have coupons?
A: Yes. We post daily and monthly coupon specials.

Q: How do I hear about monthly specials?
A: Reach out through our contact form and we will add you to our Monthly Specials email list.

Q: How soon will I hear back if I send a message?
A: If a reply is needed, you will hear back within 48 to 72 hours. For anything sooner, give us a call.
